title: Adverbs of Manner
intro:
Adverb of manner menjelaskan bagaimana sesuatu dilakukan. Kebanyakan dibentuk dari kata sifat + -ly, misalnya quick jadi quickly. Letaknya setelah kata kerja atau setelah objek.
She sings beautifully.
He drives carefully.
They finished the work quickly.

exercises.question: She sings ___.
exercises.explanation: Untuk menjelaskan cara menyanyi, pakai adverb: beautiful + -ly menjadi beautifully.

exercises.question: He drives very ___.
exercises.explanation: Careful + -ly menjadi carefully, dengan dua huruf l.

exercises.prompt: Match each adjective to its adverb
exercises.explanation: Kebanyakan kata sifat cukup ditambah -ly. Konsonan + y berubah menjadi -ily (easy jadi easily). Good tidak beraturan: adverbnya well.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the adverb
exercises.explanation: Slow + -ly menjadi slowly, menjelaskan cara berbicara.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the adverb
exercises.explanation: Easy berakhiran konsonan + y, jadi y berubah menjadi i: easily.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of manner diletakkan setelah objek: answered the question quickly.

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Adverb dari hard adalah hard, bukan hardly. Kata hardly berarti hampir tidak pernah.

exercises.question: My sister writes ___.
exercises.explanation: Good adalah kata sifat, sedangkan adverbnya well. Untuk menjelaskan cara menulis pakai well.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about how you do something, using an adverb of manner.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan adverb yang menjelaskan cara, misalnya 'I speak English slowly.'
